summary: Around 2 a.m., a black bear ripped off a window screen, opened a cracked bedroom window fully, and entered a condo on Escalante Drive in Durango; it sniffed the sleeping 17-year-old woman's head under the blankets, then swiped her stomach when she made a noise. She self-treated three scratch marks on her stomach; bruising was also noted. The bear briefly re-entered before leaving. CPW's 10th confirmed bear attack of 2026.
